entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Alex, VeloFit agent ID 302. How can I help you today?
Hi, Alex. I'm calling about my VeloBand GPS Tracker. I... I just don't use it, and I think I need to return it. I'm a bit lost on what to do.
I can certainly look into that for you. To make sure I understand correctly, is it a technical fault with the band, or is this more of a preference issue?
Oh, no, it works perfectly fine. To be honest, I think it was an impulse buy. I've changed my mind and it's all just a bit too complicated for me. I feel so overwhelmed by it.
I see. It can definitely take a little time to get used to all the features. I'd be happy to walk you through some of the settings if that would help.
That's very kind, but my heart's just not in it. I even looked into a resale marketplace but the whole process is confusing. Can't you just help me? I just want to send it back.
Of course. Let me just pull up your purchase details. I see here that the VeloBand was delivered to you 38 days ago. One moment while I check our return policy.
Okay, I've got it. According to our policy information here, items are eligible for return within 10 days of delivery. So, you are unfortunately outside the timeframe for a full refund.
Oh, really? I was so sure I had missed the deadline. That's such a relief! Thank you so much!

You're very welcome. I am processing that return authorization for you now. I'll be sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address we have on file. Just place the device back in its original packaging, attach the label, and you can drop it off at any post office.
That sounds simple enough. Thank you, Alex, you've really helped me out today.

It was my pleasure. Once we receive the item at our warehouse, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 5 to 7 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with?
You're welcome. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
